findings: Gateway receipt and outgoing HTTP receipt are alternative configured modes. The bridge responds through HTTP using the exact interaction token.
Initial acknowledgement must occur within three seconds of receipt and continuation tokens last fifteen minutes. Local queueing cannot reset either receipt-relative budget.

Ordinary public broadcast publication is not authentication. Only package-owned client ingestion supplies the private bridge; application IDs and normalized response ownership are validated before routing.
